title: Paying Ahead for the Coming Month — Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage, Approved Cases
content:
A resident or representative of an approved case may pay toward the coming month's patient pay; the payment is posted as a patient pay payment by ACH that names no charge, and it is applied, oldest service month first, when the coming month is billed. This page of Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage concerns that payment on a case whose eligibility is approved.

**When the advance is fixed.**

> The advance is fixed only after the actual charge of the last closed month stands at no more than that month's cost of care.

> The advance is not fixed until the latest month billed as an estimate stands reconciled to the actual patient pay of that month.

Put another way, both of these must already be true on the case's records when the advance is worked out: the last closed month's actual charge is no higher than that month's cost of care, and the latest month billed as an estimate stands reconciled to the actual patient pay of that month.

## The payment tool

**What it does.** `pay_patient_pay_advance_e93eb0b7` sends a payment by ACH toward the coming month's patient pay on a Medical Assistance case whose eligibility is approved: the resident or representative pays now for a month whose charge does not exist on the record. The payment is recorded on the case's billing record as a patient pay payment by ACH that is applied to no charge, and the case's patient pay balance falls by the amount paid. The payer sees a confirmation number and the new balance.

**Who runs it.** It is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it (by `call_user_discoverable_tool`); the agent does not make the payment.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `medicaid_case_id` | the reference number of the resident's Medical Assistance case the payment is made on, as the business office gives it to the payer from the case record | identifier |
| `amount` | the payment in US dollars | a positive number with 2 decimal places (cents), rounded half up to the cent; no currency symbol and no thousands separator |

**Return.** The call is complete when the receipt comes back with status received. The receipt carries the confirmation number (`confirmation_number`, the reference number of the payment entry), the case paid on (`medicaid_case_id`), the payment method (`payment_method`, always ACH), the amount (two decimals), the date received (`entry_date`, YYYY-MM-DD), the charge applied to (`applied_to_charge`, empty because the payment names no charge), the case's patient pay balance with the payment posted (`patient_pay_balance`, two decimals; a leading minus sign means a credit) and the status. An amount that is not a positive figure is refused with an error and nothing is recorded.
